tasks.title: CHOOSE THE SLUG — before anything else. Create apps/<slug>/ if absent and copy engine/'s full content into it as the starting point. Add PROMPT_HISTORY/<slug>.md and seed apps/<slug>/BUILD_STATE.json — its first field must be "slug": "<slug>" (the value you chose). Commit + push immediately as push-access proof.
tasks.notes: Chose slug 'forge-companion'. Initialized apps/forge-companion from engine/, created PROMPT_HISTORY/forge-companion.md, seeded BUILD_STATE.json with slug 'forge-companion' as first field.

tasks.title: Confirm the repo-level signing secrets exist (see SIGNING & RELEASES); do not regenerate them.

tasks.title: Implement the app described in APP_DESCRIPTION, ONE FEATURE PER COMMIT/PUSH STEP, following the per-step protocol and quality constraints above.
